NAME

session_av_state_t - Shared run state for a native or asynchronous host audio/video stream.

SYNOPSIS

#include <src/common/session/av_state.h>

Data Fields


atomic_t phase
Current session_av_state_phase_t, queried atomically by workers. uint32_t generation
Owner-managed startup token used to reject stale asynchronous completions.

Detailed Description

Shared run state for a native or asynchronous host audio/video stream.

Zero initialization represents an idle stream with no startup token. The owner serializes transitions and generation access; workers may query the atomic phase through session_av_state_should_run().
